drums.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A detuned, warbling electric piano plays a repetitive four-chord progression with heavy flutter and wow effects. A sampled acoustic drum loop features a muffled kick, a crisp snare with a short room reverb, and a steady eighth-note closed hi-hat pattern. A deep, rounded sub-bass follows the root notes of the piano chords. A vinyl crackle texture and occasional bird chirping foley are layered throughout the mix. The tempo is 85 BPM in the key of C major. The piano uses a low-pass filter that opens and closes slightly over four-bar cycles. A subtle sidechain compression effect causes the melodic elements to duck slightly on every kick drum hit.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle, bird chirping foley]
[detuned electric piano enters with four-chord progression]

[Main Section]
[sampled drum loop enters with muffled kick and crisp snare]
[sub-bass follows piano root notes]
[low-pass filter automation on piano]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[piano fades out with increasing reverb]
[vinyl crackle and bird chirping continue to silence]

bass.tags: Ambient electronic track with a focus on evolving textures and rhythmic synthesis. A deep, resonant sub-bass provides a steady low-end presence while a mid-range synth pad with a slow attack and long release creates a shifting harmonic bed. A high-frequency, percussive synth sequence with a short decay and heavy delay effect runs throughout, creating a sense of constant motion. Granular synthesis textures and filtered noise sweeps enter and exit the arrangement. The track features a steady 120 BPM tempo in 4/4 time, likely in the key of C minor. Reverb is applied generously to the higher-frequency elements to create a wide stereo image, while the low-end remains centered and dry.
